independent_review.scope: Independent raw-custody, source attribution, visual relevant-page, parcel identity, CRS derivation and distinctness review. Release integration, clean-clone tests, secret scan and CI are separate root checks.

transformation.method: Transform all 55 ring positions from the response WKT with pyproj.Transformer.from_crs(...,4326,always_xy=True), then Shapely Polygon.representative_point in WGS84.
transformation.operation: Inverse of SPCS83 Ohio South zone (US survey foot) + NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
transformation.pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=us-ft xy_out=m step inv proj=lcc lat_0=38 lon_0=-82.5 lat_1=40.0333333333333 lat_2=38.7333333333333 x_0=600000 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
transformation.accuracy_caveat: Operation accuracy is not the unknown positional accuracy of county parcel mapping or the derived campus locator.

identity.overlap_caveat: Degree-coordinate area ratio is a topology sanity check only, not a physical area metric or cadastral survey.

dedup.distance_scope: Local azimuthal-equidistant approximate geometric separation for candidate triage only; not source positional accuracy.

candidate.authority_limit: Developer-authored legal submission through its counsel in its own project dispute, directly attributed to Trenton Data Center Campus LLC. This is a company disclosure hosted by a court, not reporter narrative, a sworn affidavit, a judicial construction finding or a court inspection.
candidate.geometry_scope: One point within the exact consolidated parcel R8000060000011 linked by developer filings to Project Mila. It is not a surveyed building position, construction footprint, approved campus boundary or individual hall. The source parcel polygon is not redistributed.
